plan.notes: Recommended Course Sequence — Option 2 [MATH 3A] published on catalog p. 285 of the official 2023-2024 catalog; AS-T in Mathematics (CSU GE pattern). MATH 3B requires MATH 3A; MATH 3C requires MATH 3B; MATH 3E requires MATH 3A; MATH 3F requires MATH 3B and MATH 3E (MATH 3C is only recommended prep) — the catalog sequences MATH 3E and MATH 3F concurrently in Spring Y2. 'Major, List A' maps to major; 'US History' and 'US/CA Politics' map to core. No summer session in Option 2. Computed total 60. Revalidated 2026-10-01 against the official College of Alameda 2024-2025 catalog (CoA-Catalog-24-25_PRINT_v1.pdf, 7,590,937 bytes, 416 pages; live alameda.edu copy 404s, retrieved via Wayback Machine capture 20250808180750): recommended course sequence verified identical to the 2023-2024 transcription. The 2025-2026 catalog is published only on Curriqunet (JS-rendered, no downloadable PDF); revalidation against it is pending a live-browser pass.
